push.title: W 4-3 vs FC 4 Real | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #16)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #16 against FC 4 Real. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 16th Perfect Game for us. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 26 passes (up from your usual 20). The ball kept finding you, and that's no coincidence.
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles. Every tackle you won turned their attack into our counter.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ A hat trick against FC 4 Real, your 3rd straight match scoring. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.

THE BAD
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Leaky faucet stuff. Small drips, big bill.
- Their humans averaged 25 completed passes; you had 21. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- Tackles attempted: 4. A good number on the way to 6+.

Five minutes of this: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Talent wins games; teammates win seasons.

Go put your feet up. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC 4 Real | You: 8.9
push.body:
Hoo-wee, BellyTb1. An 8.9. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at FC 4 Real's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 1 key pass. Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ Match rating 8.9, up from your usual 7.4. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Passes attempted 27, up from your usual 22. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Keep this in your pocket: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Simple as Sunday.
- Misplaced passes 7, up from your usual 4. Think about this: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Little homework: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Back-garden drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Bring that energy back next match. - Coach Lasso
